entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • "Add File Header" codefix priority too high #80663
  • CS7036 error for a parameter 'original' that does not exist in my record. #80661

Closed

  • Regularly encountering fake errors after branch switching; only a restart resolves the issue #78659
  • F2 Rename on class only selects a part of the name #75521
    18.3
  • Provide an option for empty / self-closing tags in any XML-based language #75607
    Backlog
  • Large XML docs take up all quick info flyout space and (1) get clipped with no scrolling, and (2) hide all diagnostics #75877
    Backlog
  • Cannot detect property extension on `IEnumerable<T>` when another extension method with the same name is available #80662
  • Update BatchFixAllProvider to support Fix All in additional files #77016
  • Source Generators: suppress inconsistent line ending popup dialog #54633
    Backlog
  • Syntax highlight is missing for 'using unsafe' type aliases #77387
  • Remove unnecessary lambda expression (IDE0200) when lambda is necessary #77395
    Backlog
  • Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CodeFixes unable to load the requested types #77586
    Backlog
  • Can't disable the empty line after file-scoped namespaces. #78784
    Backlog
  • "Introduce local" in top-level program creates the local at the global scope, breaking references #78875
    Backlog
  • the new keyword "extension" (preview in C# 14) hasn't been supported properly in VS2022 #79133
    Backlog
  • IDE0071 should probably be a performance rule instead of a code style rule #80139
  • Add Quick action to remove braces from if, for, foreach blocks #54923
    Backlog
  • Support copy from documentation <code> elements when displayed in IntelliSense #54638
    Backlog
  • Source generator temporary files don't get deleted #47212
    Backlog
  • Review lack of cancellation tokens passed to TaskQueue.ScheduleTask #42679
    Backlog
  • Inconsistent Comment Spacing #42519
    Backlog
  • Spacing between list items seems too large #39500
    Backlog
  • Design concerns around work being done with IDE Analzyers/Fxers/Refactorings #29345
    Backlog
  • Quick Action for adding an XML Doc Comment #25840
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build feature.polytype-11111.05 #80660

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix: Prevent reentrancy issues in source-generated file management #80673
  • Add syntax highlighting for C# code in documentation comment `<code>` blocks #80672
    VSCode
  • Suggest name when naming incomplete tuple element #80671
    VSCode
  • Fix deconstructed local variables not being underlined when reassigned in local functions #80670
    VSCode
  • Go To Definition: Automatically navigate to user code when multiple locations include generated code #80669
  • Fix exception when adding delegate declaration to interface in SyntaxEditor #80668
    VSCode
  • Fix IDE0200: Don't suggest lambda-to-method-group conversion with nullability mismatches #80667
    VSCode
  • Fix FindReferences with a type arg in a conversion operator #80666
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Fix "Add File Header" code fix priority to prevent interference with "Remove unnecessary usings" #80665
    VSCode
  • Add options to generate XML documentation comments on a single line and control tag generation #80664
    Needs UX Triage, VSCode

Updated

  • Add support for with(...) elements in collection expressions (3). #80568
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Fix 'Add parameter' refactoring to assign property/field for primary constructors #80655
    VSCode
  • Improve diagnostic quality for less accessible base type argument #80483
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80654
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80653
